footer.tagline: Morocco's first classifieds platform. Simple, fast and secure.

premium.hero_desc: Professional tools to maximize the visibility of your listings and sell faster.
premium.f1_desc: Your listings appear at the top of search results and in featured sections.
premium.f2_desc: Premium listings sell on average 3 times faster than standard listings.
premium.f3_desc: Track views, contacts and conversions for each listing in real time.
premium.f4_desc: A Pro badge on your profile reassures buyers and increases credibility.
premium.q1: Can I cancel at any time?
premium.a1: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time at no charge. Premium access remains active until the end of the paid period.
premium.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
premium.a2: We accept bank cards (Visa, Mastercard), CMI, PayPal and bank transfer for Business plans.
premium.a3: Your listings appear at the top of search results, in the 'Premium Listings' section on the homepage, and receive a distinctive badge.
premium.a4: Yes! You get a 7-day free trial for the Pro plan. No credit card required to get started.

notice.s1_body: The SouqMar24 website (the "Website") is published by [PUBLISHER NAME], [LEGAL FORM], with registered office at [ADDRESS], [CITY], Morocco. Trade Register number (RC): [TRADE REGISTER NUMBER]. Common Business Identifier (ICE): [ICE NUMBER]. Contact email: [CONTACT EMAIL].
notice.s2_body: The publication director of the Website is [NAME OF PUBLICATION DIRECTOR], who can be reached at [CONTACT EMAIL].
notice.s3_body: The Website is hosted by [HOSTING PROVIDER NAME], with registered office at [HOSTING PROVIDER ADDRESS].
notice.s4_body: All elements of the Website (structure, text, logos, graphics, icons, source code) are protected by copyright and trademark law. Any reproduction, representation, modification or use, in whole or in part, without the publisher's prior written consent is prohibited. Content published by users (listings, photos, messages) remains the property of its authors, who warrant that they hold the rights necessary for its publication.
notice.s5_body: The processing of personal data of Website users is described in the Privacy Policy, accessible from the footer and from account settings.
notice.s6_body: SouqMar24 acts as a technical intermediary connecting private and professional buyers and sellers; it is not a party to any transaction concluded between users and cannot be held liable for the quality, legality or accuracy of published listings. This legal notice is governed by Moroccan law. Any dispute regarding its interpretation or performance falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of [CITY], subject to mandatory consumer protection rules.

privacy.s1_body: The controller responsible for processing personal data collected on SouqMar24 is [PUBLISHER NAME], reachable at [CONTACT EMAIL]. This policy describes how your data is collected, used and protected when you use the Website.
privacy.s2_body: We collect: data provided at registration (name, email address, phone number, city); data related to your listings and messages exchanged with other users; technical connection data (IP address, device type, pages viewed); and, where applicable, verification data (email or SMS verification code).
privacy.s3_body: Your data is used to: create and manage your account; publish and moderate your listings; enable messaging between users; ensure platform security and prevent fraud; send you notifications related to your activity (offers, messages, listing status); and improve our services.
privacy.s4_body: Processing is based on the performance of the contract formed with SouqMar24 when you create your account, on your consent for optional communications, and on SouqMar24's legitimate interest in ensuring the security and proper functioning of the platform.
privacy.s5_body: Your data is never sold to third parties. It may be shared with: technical providers necessary for the operation of the Website (hosting, sending emails and SMS); other users, limited to information publicly displayed on your profile and listings; and competent authorities, upon lawful request.
privacy.s6_body: Your data is kept for as long as your account remains active, then deleted or anonymized within a reasonable period after its deletion, unless a longer legal retention obligation applies (in particular for accounting purposes or in the event of an ongoing dispute).
privacy.s7_body: In accordance with Moroccan Law No. 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data, you have the right to access, rectify, object to and delete your data. You may exercise these rights directly from your account settings, or by contacting us at [CONTACT EMAIL]. You may also lodge a complaint with the National Commission for the Control of the Protection of Personal Data (CNDP).
privacy.s8_body: The Website uses cookies strictly necessary for its operation (session management, language preferences), as well as, where applicable, audience measurement cookies. You can configure your browser at any time to refuse cookies, which may limit certain features of the Website.
privacy.s9_body: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures (password encryption, secure HTTPS connections, access control) to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss or disclosure.
privacy.s10_body: Your data is hosted and processed within the infrastructure described in the legal notice. Should a transfer outside Morocco occur, it would be governed by appropriate safeguards in accordance with applicable regulations.
privacy.s11_body: This privacy policy may be updated at any time. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page. We invite you to review it regularly.

terms.s1_body: These Terms of Use ("Terms") set out the rules for accessing and using the SouqMar24 website, a classifieds platform allowing individuals and businesses to publish, browse and negotiate listings in Morocco.
terms.s2_body: Accessing and using the Website implies full and unconditional acceptance of these Terms. If you do not accept these Terms, you must refrain from using the Website.
terms.s3_body: Creating an account requires providing accurate and up-to-date information (name, email, phone number). You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for any activity carried out from your account. An account is strictly personal and may not be transferred or shared.
terms.s4_body: SouqMar24 provides a space connecting users who wish to sell, buy, rent or offer goods and services. SouqMar24 is not a party to transactions concluded between users and does not intervene in the negotiation, payment or delivery of the goods or services advertised.
terms.s5_body: Each listing must correspond to a real good or service, be described accurately and without being misleading, and be published in the appropriate category. SouqMar24 reserves the right to moderate, recategorize or remove any listing that does not comply with these Terms or applicable regulations, without prior notice.
terms.s6_body: It is prohibited to: publish listings for illegal, counterfeit, dangerous or regulated goods or services without authorization; publish false, abusive, discriminatory or fraudulent content; impersonate a third party; or use the Website for unsolicited mass solicitation (spam).
terms.s7_body: SouqMar24 may offer paid options (featured placement, premium listings). Payment, billing and, where applicable, refund terms for these options are specified at the time of subscription. These options relate solely to services provided by SouqMar24 itself, not to transactions between users.
terms.s8_body: SouqMar24 makes every effort to ensure the availability and security of the Website, without guaranteeing continuous availability or the absence of errors. SouqMar24 cannot be held liable for damages arising from the use of the Website, transactions between users, or content published by third parties. Each user is responsible for exercising caution in their interactions.
terms.s9_body: The structure of the Website, its features and editorial content are protected by intellectual property law. By publishing a listing, the user grants SouqMar24 a non-exclusive license to use, reproduce and display the content (text, photos) as necessary for the operation of the Website.
terms.s10_body: SouqMar24 may suspend or delete, temporarily or permanently, any account in the event of a breach of these Terms, without prior notice in the event of a serious breach. The user may delete their account at any time from the Website settings.
terms.s11_body: The processing of personal data in connection with the use of the Website is described in the Privacy Policy, which forms an integral part of these Terms.
terms.s12_body: SouqMar24 reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time. Users will be informed of any material change. Continued use of the Website after a change constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.
terms.s13_body: These Terms are governed by Moroccan law. In the event of a dispute, an amicable solution will be sought first; failing that, the competent courts shall be those of [CITY], subject to mandatory provisions applicable to consumers.
terms.s14_body: For any questions regarding these Terms, you may contact us at [CONTACT EMAIL].

withdrawal.s1_body: The right of withdrawal described below applies exclusively to paid services subscribed directly with SouqMar24 (featured placement options, premium listings). It does not apply to transactions of goods or services concluded between users through the Website, as SouqMar24 is not a party to such transactions.
withdrawal.s2_body: In accordance with consumer protection principles applicable in Morocco, you have a period of 14 days from the date of subscribing to a paid service with SouqMar24 to exercise your right of withdrawal, without having to state a reason.
withdrawal.s3_title: Exceptions to the right of withdrawal
withdrawal.s3_body: In accordance with practices applicable to digital content, the right of withdrawal cannot be exercised if performance of the paid service (for example, immediate featured placement of a listing) has begun before the end of the 14-day period with your express agreement and express waiver of your right of withdrawal.
withdrawal.s4_body: To exercise your right of withdrawal, send an unambiguous statement to [CONTACT EMAIL], indicating the reference of the service concerned and the subscription date.
withdrawal.s5_body: In the event of a validly exercised withdrawal, SouqMar24 will refund the amounts paid for the service concerned within a reasonable period, using the same payment method used at the time of subscription, unless otherwise agreed.
withdrawal.s6_body: For any questions regarding your right of withdrawal, contact us at [CONTACT EMAIL].
